paragraphs.text: Skavius Slan was a lich on Shandalar , who used the empty body of Azar after the Wizard's War . The lichlord took command of the Black Guild and ruled for ages, even after the passing of the other Guildlords of Shandalar .

Skavius Slan's forces included necromancers , nether fiends , vampire lords , undead knights , witches and warlocks , Lords of Fate , Mind Stealers , Centaur Shamans , Sedge Beasts , Aga Galneer djinni , Mandurang dragons .

The guildlords and the guilds themselves were originally of pure intent to defend Shandalar but were corrupted by the evil Planeswalker Arzakon 's influence in the guise of a benevolent advisor. Together, they betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar during Arzakon's War , to open the path for Arzakon.
The Guildlords, including Skavius Slan, were in turn defeated, and Arzakon was banned from entering the plane.
